events.title: World News in Brief: Gulf tensions rise, Gaza health needs ‘staggering’, skills gap threat
events.summary: The UN has expressed deep concern over escalating security incidents in the Gulf, warning that recent attacks risk undermining efforts to maintain regional stability.

events.title: In Lebanon, the same fears and dangers persist despite ceasefire: UNHCR
events.summary: Death and destruction have continued unabated in Lebanon while communities are still unable to return to their homes despite a ceasefire that began on 17 April, humanitarians said on Tuesday.

events.title: UN warns of worsening human rights crisis in Mali after deadly attacks
events.summary: The human rights situation in Mali is rapidly deteriorating following coordinated attacks by armed groups across the country, with civilians killed, displaced and cut off from food and aid, UN rights office OHCHR said on Tuesday.
